SELECT ssc.id, ssc.student_id AS studentId, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.student_name AS studentName, ssc.type AS changeType, ssc.reason, ssc.start_date AS startDate, ssc.end_date AS endDate, ssc.mentor_approval AS mentorStatus, ssc.mentor_id AS mentorId, t.teacher_name AS mentorName, ssc.mentor_approval_time AS mentorApprovalTime, ssc.secretary_approval AS secretaryStatus, ssc.secretary_id AS secretaryId, ssc.secretary_approval_time AS secretaryApprovalTime, ssc.status, ssc.create_time AS createTime, ssc.update_time AS updateTime FROM student_status_change ssc LEFT JOIN student st ON ssc.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ssc.mentor_id = t.id
AND ssc.student_id = #{studentId}
AND ssc.type = #{changeType}
AND st.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
AND st.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentName}, '%')
AND ssc.mentor_approval = 0
AND ssc.mentor_approval = 1 AND (ssc.secretary_approval IS NULL OR ssc.secretary_approval = 0)
AND ssc.mentor_approval = 1 AND ssc.secretary_approval = 1
AND (ssc.mentor_approval = 2 OR ssc.secretary_approval = 2)
AND ssc.mentor_id = #{mentorId}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ssc.status = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ssc.create_time DESC

SELECT ssc.id, ssc.student_id AS studentId, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.student_name AS studentName, ssc.type AS changeType, ssc.reason, ssc.start_date AS startDate, ssc.end_date AS endDate, ssc.mentor_approval AS mentorStatus, ssc.mentor_id AS mentorId, t.teacher_name AS mentorName, ssc.mentor_approval_time AS mentorApprovalTime, ssc.secretary_approval AS secretaryStatus, ssc.secretary_id AS secretaryId, ssc.secretary_approval_time AS secretaryApprovalTime, ssc.status, ssc.create_time AS createTime, ssc.update_time AS updateTime FROM student_status_change ssc LEFT JOIN student st ON ssc.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ssc.mentor_id = t.id WHERE ssc.id = #{id}
